reduction_convention.ordinary_side_vertex: a degree-2-in-blob tree vertex carrying one outgoing cut-edge port
reduction_convention.source_S: the unique incoming-cut-edge tree vertex, or the global degree-2 root before semi-directed suppression
reduction_convention.sink_X: a degree-2-in-blob reticulation whose outgoing cut edge leaves the blob

undirected_cores.description: two distinguished event vertices S,X joined by two side paths
two branch vertices U,V joined by three side paths

orientation_cores.minimal_repair_rule: subdivide either one of the two S-to-X sides
subdivide either one of the two V-to-X segments
independently choose one U-to-X and one V-to-X segment
subdivide one of the two U-to-R sides and the R-to-X segment
subdivide either U-to-R or U-to-X, and always subdivide R-to-X

expansion_rules: Subdivide any directed segment by an arbitrary ordered chain of ordinary tree port vertices.
Every inserted port points by a cut edge to a tree vertex or labelled leaf in a leaf-containing component.
Choose subdivisions meeting one of the minimal strong-repair sets computed by the verifier.
Do not leave two distinct core sides as parallel arcs, and do not create an oppositely directed two-cycle.
Every binary strongly tree-child level-2 blob is obtained uniquely up to core automorphism and contraction of ordinary port chains.
